conclusions.verified_title: LowFER: Low-rank Bilinear Pooling for Link Prediction
conclusions.publication: arXiv2020v1; venue status not independently audited
conclusions.operation: Shared projected subject and relation Hadamard product, grouped summation pooling, dot target readout; generic factorized bilinear pooling derivation projects both inputs
conclusions.precise_difference: Actual multiplicative inputs are subject/relation, not both graph endpoints; shared lookup tables rather than shared GNN/member ensemble
conclusions.contradicted_claim: Learned coordinate transforms before Hadamard fusion are a new link-prediction primitive
conclusions.strong_alternative: Prospectively fixed factorized bilinear endpoint channels under native decoder; architecture adaptation, not direct whole-recipe transfer
conclusions.printed_semantics_caveat: Section3.3 printed minimization of log terms lacks leading minus although prose states binary cross-entropy; no native reproduction claim
